name: Claude Code instructions note
description: Adds the 'Commands for the owner (o-cmds)' note to Claude Code's user instructions, between o-cmds markers; the rest of the file is untouched.
content:
## Commands for the owner (o-cmds)

Whenever you give the owner a command, code or a multi-step recipe to run (a one-liner, build and run, open a page, a check), first record it in o-cmds as a self-contained bash/zsh script, and tell the owner its name. Put any cd and temp env inside the script. Never put secrets or work-host details in it. The owner runs it with `o-cmds cmd run NAME|N` or from the `o-cmds` TUI (newest at the bottom).

Record and read commands only through mtm: the mtm MCP gateway (`run` with `cmd.cmd add`, passing `name`, `desc` and the script as `script`) or, without MCP, the mtm CLI (`mtm cmd add --name SLUG --desc "<what it does>"` with the script on stdin). After the owner has run it, check what happened with `mtm cmd jobs NAME` and the job logs (`mtm cmd job list`, `mtm cmd job show|out|err`; MCP `cmd.job list|show|out|err`). Never call the `o-cmds` binary or another MCP server directly.
